item.title: I’m disgusted with the amount of feral cats in Marion County
item.description: "I have lived in Dunnellon for three years and every year a cat or dog appears at my house in the forest. I took both cats and one large dog to be neutered. Found a home for one of the younger cats. Fostered/adopted dog. It's ridiculous. Marion County Animal Control will not come out for cats even if you're a senior citizen.
